services.name: Cabins & Outpost
services.desc: Our guests enjoy the fresh clean air and the pristine beauty of the Canadian Northwoods, from the decks of our fully modern housekeeping cabins. These waterfront cabins are conveniently located with easy access to other Cozy Camp amenities including dock space provided just steps away from the front door. These clean, spacious, cabins have up to 3 bedrooms and can comfortably sleep up to 8 people. All are fully furnished including a sitting area with a sofa & chair so you can relax after a day of fabulous fishing! Two of them have sofa beds for extra sleeping space. Our remote location on the Walleye-stuffed English River system is one of the top Walleye fishing destinations in Ontario.

services.name: Pontoon rental
services.desc: We have newer 16-foot Lund fishing boats with padded swivel seats and Mercury 15hp and 20hp 4-stroke motors. Due to popular demand, we added a 2009 21-foot Crestliner Suncast Pontoon Boat with a 40hp 4-stroke motor. It's set up for fishing with depth finder, live well and front fishing seats. The boat is a very stable casting platform for pike and bass casting. It's like fishing from a bass boat. Pontoon boat fishing package price is: $679 per person with a minimum of four adults. No daily rentals. Please see our rate page for details. It can be used for more than just fishing. The pontoon boat holds up to 6 people.
